about: Fiddle tunes in 6/8 and a major key from four collections printed between about 1780 and 1903 (O'Neill's Music of Ireland, Aird's Airs, Ryan's Mammoth Collection, two small folk books), moved to D major, on an eighth-note grid. One number per eighth note: 0 to P-1 is a pitch (0 is MIDI 57), P is HOLD, P+1 is REST. q0 is where the first note sits against the bar (-1 is a pickup note).
